title: 7156:Support quoted string labels in architecture diagrams
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR fixes a parsing error in `architecture-beta` diagrams where labels wrapped in quotes
(e.g. ["Database"]) caused a syntax error.
Resolves #7156
